newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving up on fresh commitment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving up on fresh commitment.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may move up as investors are expected to return after Saturday's gain and make fresh commitments, brokers said.

"Share prices may gain because investors' confidence has been boosted by the withdrawal of restriction on bank credit against shares and the recovery made on Saturday," said broker Khurshid Alam. Brokers said the scrips in engineering and pharmaceutical sectors might gain slightly.
The DSE benchmark index closed 31.63 points or 1.04 percent up at 3,064.99 on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
